test_forward_lin_bound_fc: test forward linear bounds for fully connected layers using fastlin or crown relaxers with and without elision
test_forward_lin_bound_conv2d: test forward linear bounds for 2D convolutional layers using fastlin or crown relaxers with and without elision
test_forward_lin_bound_conv1d: test forward linear bounds for 1D convolutional layers using fastlin or crown relaxers with and without elision
test_forward_lin_bound_relu: test forward linear bounds for ReLU activation functions using fastlin bound propagation
test_ibp_forward_fastlin_bound_propagati: test ibp forward fastlin bound propagation for fully connected, convolutional, and ReLU layers
